status: Sanitized structural-fixture baseline — not an end-to-end benchmark

source.range: Generated from a clean, temporary Git repository with one unstaged Python change; the repository path and runtime-duration fields are sanitized before publication.
source.license: DiffGraph-CLI is MIT licensed; this minimal fixture is checked in as a sanitized example.

repeat.expected: Validates the checked-in diff, artifact, pinned CLI source revision and generator version, schema, AI-off metadata, Tree-sitter parser evidence against reconstructed Git post-images, sanitized publication metadata, and SHA-256 digests without network access.

limitations: This fixture proves only a static, deterministic CLI artifact and its checked-in diff and artifact evidence; it does not establish the original source-change provenance.
It does not measure clean installation, extension packaging, provider recovery, performance, cancellation, cache behavior, or reviewer-task outcomes.
Those end-to-end acceptance results remain required before the website can claim a measured daily-driver workflow.
